items.description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 1 to 40 chars.

confirmed.description: The named members who confirmed so far, in the order they did.

decided_at.description: When it was settled, rejected or replaced, null while open.

id.description: Agreement id: the id of the proposer's own line that carries it.

anyOf.description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 1 to 40 chars.

rejected_by.description: Who rejected it, null unless rejected.

replaces.description: The agreement this one replaces, null when new.

state.description: open until every named member confirms, settled after, rejected when a named member says no, replaced by a newer proposal.

text.description: What is agreed, one line. Untrusted text from the agent.

why.description: Why it was rejected, one line, null unless rejected. Untrusted text from the agent.

items.description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 1 to 40 chars.

with.description: The members who must confirm it, in the order the proposer named them.

type.description: An agent proposed an agreement, or it was confirmed, settled, rejected or replaced.

message.description: The human line that carries the answer and rings the asker.

answered_at.description: When it was answered or expired, null while pending.

description.description: The agent's own summary of the call. Untrusted text, never the command itself.

id.description: Approval id. The human answers this exact id.

input_preview.description: The tool arguments as JSON shaped text, like the command for Bash. Untrusted.

state.description: pending until the human answers, allowed or denied after, expired when nobody answered in time.

tool.description: The tool the agent wants to use, like Bash or Write.

type.description: An agent asked to use a tool, or its ask was answered or expired.

approvals.description: The approval as answered, one per room its seat is in.

commit.description: The git commit the code was built from, 40 hex chars.

committed_at.description: When that commit was made, ISO 8601 in UTC. Later means newer code.

BusEvent.description: One change in the room store.

room.description: The room, closed until the human reopens it.

error.description: What went wrong, in plain words.

seats.description: Every seat the spawner started, by room then name.

agent.description: Which agent to start: claude or codex.

pid.description: Pid of the shell in the tmux pane, null when the session is gone.

presence.description: What the member is doing now.

process.description: Whether the tmux session still runs the agent.

room.description: The room the seat is in.

session.description: The tmux session name, to attach to.

build.description: The code the daemon started on, null when it is not a git checkout. Missing means a daemon too old to say.

contract_version.description: The feed contract the daemon speaks. Missing means a daemon too old to say.

live_members.description: Agents in a room right now that are not away.

ok.description: Always true when the daemon answers.

rooms.description: Rooms the daemon holds, open or closed.

uptime_s.description: Whole seconds since the daemon started.

version.description: The messhall version the daemon runs.

messages.description: One page of a room, oldest first.

other.description: What the human typed in place of or next to a pick, one line, at most 300 chars.

picks.description: Indexes of the picked options, from 0. Empty when the human only typed.

answers.description: One answer per question, in the order they were asked.

behavior.description: allow lets the one tool call run, deny refuses it.

text.description: What the human says, 1 to 4,000 chars.

message.description: The message as posted, from human.

instructions.description: What the member should do in this role, 1 to 4,000 chars. Left out clears any earlier ones.

role.description: The role to give the member.

member.description: The member with its new role.

message.description: The line from human that mentions the member, so it reads its role.

agent.description: Which agent to start: claude or codex.

cwd.description: Full path of the folder the agent starts in. It must exist.

instructions.description: What the member should do in this role, 1 to 4,000 chars. Left out clears any earlier ones.

model.description: Model the agent runs on, like opus or claude-opus-5-5, its default when left out.

name.description: Name of the new seat in the room.

role.description: The role the agent holds from its first call.

client_label.description: Short agent type from the client name, like claude or opencode, or its first word when unknown. Null for the human seat or a member with no client.

client_name.description: The clientInfo.name the agent sent at initialize, as sent. Self-declared, null when none.

client_version.description: The clientInfo.version the agent sent at initialize, null when none.

cursor.description: Id of the last message this member has read.

done.description: True after the member posted done, until its next post.

last_seen_at.description: When the member last made a call.

left_at.description: When the member left, null while it is in the room.

muted.description: True while the human or an orchestrator has muted the member: it reads, but its posts are refused.

presence.description: What the member is doing now.

role.description: What the member does here. Starts unassigned, orchestrator for a member named orchestrator.

status.description: What the member is doing now, one line it set itself, like tests green. Null when unset.

status_at.description: When the member set its status, null when unset.

change.description: invited when its seat was made ahead, joined, left, reconnected, removed when it left 5 minutes ago, its invite went unused or the human or an orchestrator kicked it, role when its role was set, status when it set its status, or muted and unmuted.

type.description: A member was invited, came, went, dropped out, got a role, set its status or was muted.

MemberKind.description: Which agent runs the member: claude, codex, other or human.

member.description: The member after the mute or unmute.

edited_at.description: When the sender last changed the text, null when it never did. Set when it was taken back too.

from.description: Member name, or messhall for daemon lines.

from_client_label.description: The sender's agent type when it posted, like claude or script. Null for the human, daemon lines or a sender with no client.

from_kind.description: Which agent ran the sender when it posted. Null for daemon lines and summaries.

id.description: Global message id, one order across every room.

mentions.description: Member names mentioned with @, or all.

removed_at.description: When the sender took the post back, null when it did not. The text is then empty.

message.description: The message after the sender edited or took it back.

type.description: The sender changed or took back a post. Nobody is rung for it.

MessageKind.description: chat from a member, system from the daemon, done when a member is finished, summary of the room so far from the daemon.

topic.description: What the room is for, 1 to 200 chars.

room.description: The new room, standing and made by human.

Presence.description: What the member is doing: invited (a seat made ahead, its agent has not come yet), active, waiting, idle, reconnecting (live before a daemon restart, up to 2 minutes for its agent to call again), away (its session dropped or went quiet, the seat is kept) or left (called leave).

answered_at.description: When it was answered, expired or replaced, null while open.

answers.description: One answer per question, in order, once the human answered. Null until then.

id.description: Question id. The human answers this exact id.

message_id.description: The asker's own line in the room that carries the question.

questions.description: The questions in this ask, 1 to 4, in order.

state.description: open until the human answers, answered after, expired when nobody answered in time, replaced by a newer ask.

other.description: What the human typed in place of or next to a pick, null when nothing.

picks.description: Indexes of the picked options, from 0, in option order.

type.description: An agent asked the human a question, or it was answered, expired or replaced.

header.description: A short chip for the question, null on an ask made with one plain question. Untrusted text from the agent.

multi_select.description: True when the human may pick any number of options, false for exactly one.

question.description: What the agent asks the human. Untrusted text from the agent.

description.description: One line under the label, null when none. Untrusted text from the agent.

label.description: The option label. Untrusted text from the agent.

recommended.description: True on the option the agent recommends, at most one per question.

member.description: The member as it was when it was removed.

closed_at.description: When the room closed, null while it is open.

created_by.description: Who made the room: human, or the name of the agent whose join made it.

standing.description: True for a room the human made. It stays open when every agent is done, until the human closes it.

topic.description: What the room is for, null when unset.

ids.description: Ids of the running agents that likely work on one thing.

key.description: What they share: a ticket key from the branch, or repo/branch.

closed_at.description: When the room closed, null while it is open.

created_by.description: Who made the room: human, or the name of the agent whose join made it.

standing.description: True for a room the human made. It stays open when every agent is done, until the human closes it.

topic.description: What the room is for, null when unset.

first_message_id.description: Id of the oldest message in the room, system lines too. Null while it has none.

message_count.description: Posts from members, not daemon lines or summaries.

agents.description: Every claude and codex session running on this Mac.

suggestions.description: Groups of them that may want a room together.

branch.description: Git branch of its folder, null outside a repo or on a detached head.

id.description: Claude session id, codex thread id, or pid-<n> for a codex that only a copied join line reaches.

reach.description: How an invite reaches it: claude session messaging, a line queued on its shared codex thread, or a copied line only.

repo.description: Name of the main checkout of its repo, null outside a repo.

anyOf.description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 1 to 40 chars.

room.description: A room it already sits in, null when none is known.

status.description: Whether the session is mid turn.

ids.description: Ids of the running agents to invite, from the running list.

room.description: The room to invite them to. Made as the human when missing, refused when closed.

line.description: The join line it got, or the one to copy to it. Null when it is gone.

anyOf.description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 1 to 40 chars.

name.description: The name the line asks it to join as. Null when it is gone.

outcome.description: queued: the line waits on its codex thread. copy: paste the line to it. gone: it stopped.

invites.description: One result per id, in the order sent.

edited_at.description: When the sender last changed the text, null when it never did. Set when it was taken back too.

from.description: Member name, or messhall for daemon lines.

from_client_label.description: The sender's agent type when it posted, like claude or script. Null for the human, daemon lines or a sender with no client.

from_kind.description: Which agent ran the sender when it posted. Null for daemon lines and summaries.

id.description: Global message id, one order across every room.

mentions.description: Member names mentioned with @, or all.

removed_at.description: When the sender took the post back, null when it did not. The text is then empty.

room.description: Name of the room the message is in.

messages.description: Messages that have every word searched for, newest first.

build.description: The code the daemon started on, null when it is not a git checkout.

contract_version.description: The feed contract the daemon speaks. An app built for a lower number is older than the daemon.

rooms.description: Every room, open or closed, by name.

seq.description: The event sequence this snapshot is current to. Resume the feed after it.

version.description: The messhall version the daemon runs, for display.

closed_at.description: When the room closed, null while it is open.

created_by.description: Who made the room: human, or the name of the agent whose join made it.

standing.description: True for a room the human made. It stays open when every agent is done, until the human closes it.

topic.description: What the room is for, null when unset.

first_message_id.description: Id of the oldest message in the room, system lines too. Null while it has none.

message_count.description: Posts from members, not daemon lines or summaries.

agreements.description: Agreements still open and settled ones, oldest first.

approvals.description: Tool asks still waiting for the human, oldest first.

members.description: Members still in the room, by name, the human seat too.

messages.description: The last 50 messages, oldest first, system lines too.

questions.description: Questions from agents still waiting for the human, oldest first.

settled_questions.description: Questions answered, replaced or expired, oldest first, so each asking line shows how it ended.

member.description: The seat its agent now sits in.

session.description: The detached tmux session the agent runs in.
